page.overview:
Who is Baconin Borzacchini?

Baconin Borzacchini (September 28, 1898 - September 10, 1933) was an Italian pre-war racing driver.

He was one of three drivers to die in the ill-fated 1933 Italian Grand Prix, along with fellow driver Giuseppe Campari and Polish Count Stanislas Czaykowski.
